questions.question_text: Derive equivalent resistance formula for three resistors R1, R2, R3 connected in parallel.
options: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D
questions.correct_answer: Total current I = I1 + I2 + I3. By Ohm's law: I = V/Rp, I1=V/R1, I2=V/R2, I3=V/R3. Substituting: V/Rp = V/R1 + V/R2 + V/R3 => 1/Rp = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + 1/R3.
